name: Vietnamese Mahjong
description: Vietnamese Mahjong is a Southeast Asian Mahjong profile commonly played with expanded bonus and joker-style tiles. It uses a larger 160-tile composition and regional scoring conventions.

setup.deck: 160-tile Mahjong set with expanded bonus/joker-style groups.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer receives 14 and discards first.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand and satisfy active Vietnamese scoring rules.
rules.gameplay: Players draw and discard in turn, claim legal sets under priority rules, and resolve expanded bonus/joker-style tiles by profile conventions.
keyRules: Draw then discard is the core loop.
Claim legality and priority determine interruptions.
Expanded bonus/joker-style handling follows profile rules.

strategy.advanced: Balance completion speed, bonus value, and defensive timing under expanded-tile interactions.
